what: A rail beside a long story page with one dot per section stacked vertically (cell 47px · dot 12px). Dots are joined by a 2px dotted line, and the line below sections already passed becomes solid. When a section card’s center enters the top 25% of the screen center, a 7px ring is placed on that section’s dot, and if that section’s background is light the rail flips to a dark color, if dark to a light color. Clicking a dot smoothly scrolls that section card’s center to the center of the screen

options.from: Section selector (css), default [data-fx-part=chapter] — one dot per section
options.start: Rail type before the first section, light·dark, default dark
options.[data-fx-part=card]: (if inside the section) card that measures the center — if absent, the section’s first child
options.data-tone: Section background brightness light·dark — if missing, .--cream·.--light types are treated as light
options.--fx-rail · --fx-gap: Rail color (css, default --kf-ink — the user sets color to match .--on-light·.--on-dark) · cell height

from.where: index.html·ar.html .bz-rail — original ab-rail: li 47px · dot 12px · 2px dashed → done is solid · aria-current ring 7px · on-light/on-dark
